requests.description: Creates an alarm model to monitor an AWS IoT Events input attribute. You can use the alarm to get notified when the value is outside a specified range. For more information, see Create an alarm model in the AWS IoT Events Developer Guide.
requests.name: POST /alarm-models
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_IOT_EVENTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Retrieves runtime information about a detector model analysis.

After AWS IoT Events starts analyzing your detector model, you have up to 24 hours to retrieve the analysis results.
requests.name: GET /analysis/detector-models/{analysisId}
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_IOT_EVENTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves the current settings of the AWS IoT Events logging options.
requests.name: GET /logging
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_IOT_EVENTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Sets or updates the AWS IoT Events logging options.

If you update the value of any loggingOptions field, it takes up to one minute for the change to take effect. If you change the policy attached to the role you specified in the roleArn field (for example, to correct an invalid policy), it takes up to five minutes for that change to take effect.
requests.name: PUT /logging
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_IOT_EVENTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
Retrieves one or more analysis results of the detector model.

After AWS IoT Events starts analyzing your detector model, you have up to 24 hours to retrieve the analysis results.
requests.name: GET /analysis/detector-models/{analysisId}/results
requests.note: Replace {{AWS_IOT_EVENTS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
